title: Fingerprints of classical memory in quantum hysteresis
summary: We present a simple framework for classical and quantum ``memory'' in which the Hamiltonian at time $t$ depends on past values of a control Hamiltonian through a causal kernel. This structure naturally describes finite-bandwidth or filtered control channels and provides a clean way to distinguish between memory in the control and genuine non-Markovian dynamics of the state. We focus on models where $H(t)=H_0+\int_{-\infty}^{t}K(t-s)\,H_1(s)\,ds$, and illustrate the framework on single-qubit examples such as $H(t)=σ_z+Φ(t)σ_x$ with $Φ(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}K(t-s)\,u(s)\,ds$.
